title: Helpful and professional staff
summary: Feedback about staff focuses on helpful, polite, and professional service across reception, sales, and service interactions, while many excerpts are too incomplete or ambiguous to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise staff for being helpful, kind, polite, knowledgeable, and professional in reception, service, and dealership interactions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention staff in ways that are fragmentary, context-dependent, or sentiment-ambiguous, so the staff experience cannot be summarized confidently from them alone.

limitations: Many sampled excerpts are short or truncated, which limits confidence in interpreting the full staff experience.
Several undetermined fragments contain sentiment-bearing language but remain classified as undetermined in the supplied data, so they cannot be reassigned here.
The examples center on staff behavior across sales, service, and reception, but they do not provide enough detail to compare those subtopics reliably.
